technical.zh-CN: Hu-MLS 使用反向行星滚柱丝杠；Hu-MRS 标题称谐波旋转执行器，但正文写中空行星减速机，存在结构描述冲突，暂不据此判定具体减速路线。
technical.en: Hu-MLS uses an inverted planetary roller screw. Hu-MRS is titled a strain-wave rotary actuator but described as using a hollow planetary gearbox. Its transmission route remains unresolved.
